newsitem.title: USA: MGM Grand stock sags after Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: MGM Grand stock sags after Q4 earnings.

text.p: MGM Grand Inc shares dipped 1-1/4 to 38-1/2 on Thursday after the company reported a fourth quarter operating profit of $0.50 a share, fully taxed, versus $0.42 a share on the same basis one year ago.
Financial analysts pegged today's stock slide to possible profit-taking after the earnings report, noting MGM Grand shares have risen rapidly since early January.
"Expectations were for a terrific number and MGM delivered on that," said David McDonald of Montgomery Securities.
Analysts had forecast earnings of $0.41 a share, according to First Call.
Shares of MGM Grand have risen steadily to a closing price high of 40 a share on Tuesday from 34-1/2 on January 6.

David Wolfe, analyst at Oppenheimber & Co, noted that in the last several quarters MGM shares have been run-up preceding the company's earnings announcement only to fall back when the company meets expectations.
"This just seems to be a pattern that has set in," Wolfe said.
